claim_text: The skull of Eohippus (Hyracotherium) is transformed into that of Equus by coordinate deformation, with actual and hypothetical intermediates (after Heilmann) lying on the transformation.

state_variables.landmarks: 18 homologous lateral skull landmarks (Cardini 2019-style face/braincase scheme, Table S2 analogue)

equations.formula: phi: R^2 -> R^2 smooth, det(D phi) > 0
equations.role: Thompson coordinate map carrying Eohippus grid to Equus

boundary_conditions: Endpoints fixed: phi_0 = Eohippus configuration, phi_1 = Equus configuration
Intermediate stages at t in {1/4, 1/2, 3/4} on the same correspondence
empirical_claims: Heilmann intermediates lie on the Eohippus→Equus coordinate transformation (diagrammatic)
Modern equid skull evolution may deviate from pervasive CREA pattern (Wisniewski & Slater 2026; not a direct Thompson test)
